verses.fatiha-1: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
verses.fatiha-2: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds
verses.fatiha-3: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
verses.fatiha-4: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
verses.fatiha-5: It is You we worship and You we ask for help
verses.fatiha-6: Guide us to the straight path
verses.fatiha-7: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
verses.kawthar-1: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar
verses.kawthar-2: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]
verses.kawthar-3: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
verses.ikhlas-3: He neither begets nor is born
verses.ikhlas-4: Nor is there to Him any equivalent
verses.falaq-1: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.falaq-2: From the evil of that which He created
verses.falaq-3: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.falaq-4: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.falaq-5: And from the evil of an envier when he envies
